name: Osananajimi no Nukumori
source:
A couple is on the verge of breaking up. But they realize one day that love is something you do. They regain cheerful spirits then. Childhood friend is so beautiful when she lies on the bed. I wish this day lasts forever.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一对情侣走到了分手的边缘。但有一天他们意识到，爱是需要用行动去表达的。于是他们重拾了往日的欢乐。青梅竹马躺在床上的样子是如此美丽。真希望这一天能永远持续下去。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
